proposals.evidence: Turner connects cimṭā pincers and the pinch/cling verbs with *cimb. Platts explicitly gives cimṭī both pincers and ant and cross-refers the larger-ant cīṅṭā to cimṭā; this supplies the otherwise missing insect sense. The Nepal survey cimṭ-/cimt- forms are compared within this lexical family, without extending the analysis to the separate ciũṭ-/cuṭ- series.
